name: display-switch
title: Display Switch
description: Quickly enable and disable individual displays in a multi-monitor setup.
author: niechen

commands.name: displays
commands.title: Toggle Displays
commands.description: Search displays and press Enter to turn one on or off.
commands.subtitle: Display Switch

commands.name: enable-all
commands.title: Enable All Displays
commands.description: Reconnect all displays currently disabled in macOS.
commands.subtitle: Display Switch

commands.name: toggle-display
commands.title: Toggle Display by Name
commands.description: Toggle one display by exact name or UUID. Set a hotkey for quick access.
commands.subtitle: Display Switch

scripts.build: node scripts/verify-helpers.mjs && ray build -e dist -o dist --exit-on-error --non-interactive
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
